title: Keep a record of every redemption

cases.says: an approved redemption gets one row with its last four digits, amount, response code and outcome
a declined redemption keeps its row, because the row is written on a connection of its own that the rollback doesn't reach
the lookup value is a keyed HMAC of the card number, the same for every redemption of the card
every connection the recorder borrows goes back to the pool, so later transactions still get one

origin.section: 9.6 A Decline Is Recorded Outside the Transaction That Rolls It Back
